'''Ley Neetels''' was a [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who lived at least three [[Millennium/Legends|thousand]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. As a member of the Pa'lowick [[Species/Legends|race]], Neetels perceived [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] as a dissonant mixture of [[Music/Legends|musical]] tones emanating throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. This trait compelled Neetels to seek balance in the Force by discovering new [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] as a [[Scout/Legends|space explorer]].<ref name="FaD" />

While investigating the planet [[Jerrilek]], Neetels became drawn to a familiar musical sensation through the Force, believing it to be an undiscovered location in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. [[Pilot/Legends|Piloting]] the ''[[Wandering Diva]]'', the Pa'lowick Jedi relied on the Force as a guide, making several [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps while pursuing the source of the musical tones. This search ultimately led Neetels to the world of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], along with the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Ashla (moon)/Legends|Ashla]] and [[Bogan]].<ref name="FaD" />
